units.source_text: 真个送了各种美丽的彩衣来。

en.t: He truly sent various beautiful colored robes.

units.source_text: 又有迁居时犒赏众人的物品，虽不十分隆重，却也按照各人身份，考虑非常周到，这份贺仪实甚丰厚。

en.t: There were also gifts to reward everyone on the occasion of the move; though not especially grand, they were chosen with careful regard for each person's rank, and the congratulatory offering was very generous.

units.source_text: 众侍女告二女公子：“薰中纳言大人处处不忘旧情，其诚恳实甚难得。

en.t: The ladies-in-waiting said to the Second Princess, "Lord Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, never forgets old ties in anything he does; such sincerity is truly rare.

units.source_text: 亲兄弟也不会如此关切呢！”

en.t: Even a real brother would not show such concern!"

units.source_text: 几个老年侍女对风情已不感兴趣，但觉受此重赏，真心感激。

en.t: Some of the older ladies-in-waiting no longer cared for romance, but receiving such generous rewards made them sincerely grateful.

units.source_text: 年轻的侍女相与告道：“过去二小姐常得和他会见，今后居处各异，不易得见了。

en.t: The younger ladies-in-waiting said to one another, "In the past the Second Princess was often able to meet him, but from now on they will live in different places, and it will be hard for them to see each other.

units.source_text: 不知二小姐将何等挂念他呢。”

en.t: How deeply the Second Princess must miss him now."
